name: ogsr-imgui
description: Dear ImGui (ocornut/imgui v1.93.0-docking) for OGSR Engine: static core library with docking and imgui_stdlib, no backends (the engine has its own); imconfig.h turns on IMGUI_ENABLE_TEST_ENGINE (item hooks for the engine's own UI test locator, not the Test Engine library) and routes IM_ASSERT in every configuration to ImGuiOgsr_AssertFailed, which the consumer defines.
